name: Mock Indian Pudding
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: ½ small loaf baker’s entire wheat bread

steps: Remove crusts from bread and cut into five slices of uniform thickness.
Spread generously with butter, arrange in baking-dish, pour over three cups of milk and molasses.
Bake from two to three hours in a very slow oven, stirring three times during the first hour of baking, then add remaining milk.
Serve with cream or vanilla ice cream.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
